items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: He had a beautiful tone. Well, he's dead now. Well, that's who he started out with.

ctx.x: Bill was playing his snares not too long ago.

Well, Bill was playing. That's the first sister we picked up. Drum. Yeah, he picked up drum. He used to play with a, oh, I forget the name of the band. I know the fellow who used to play trumpet. He was dead now. He was dead now. Lego. Lego? Lego, yeah. He was a good trumpet player too. That was old time. He had a beautiful tone. He had a beautiful tone. Well, he's dead now. Well, that's who he started out with. And finally, after he picked the, he started playing tram along with it. You heard about Punch. But he…

He could play too. Are there any of the other old time bands here that you can remember? For instance, they tell me about the Johnson brothers, Yank and the other. Yank, yeah. Yeah, it was Yank. There were two brothers. Both of them playing tram along. Buddy.
